# Nuance Media

> Nuance Media is a performance marketing agency in Surat and Mumbai, India, co-founded by Nishant Sinha and Lokesh Shinkar. It runs Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads, makes UGC video ads and ad creatives, and builds websites with SEO for D2C, B2B and ecommerce brands. It is measured on sales and leads, reported from Meta Ads Manager every week.

Key facts:
- Services: Meta ads management (with in-house ad creatives), UGC video production, website development and SEO. Google ads and tracking setup when they support these.
- Not offered: social media management, marketplace ads (Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra), celebrity influencer campaigns, PR, print or TV, fake followers or reviews.
- Results (from client Ads Manager reports): 7.11x ROAS in one month and 6.06x blended ROAS for a wellness D2C brand; 203 leads at ₹58 each in two weeks for a corporate gifting brand; 500+ UGC videos produced.
- Locations: Surat, Gujarat; Worli, Mumbai, Maharashtra. Works with brands across India.
- Contact: +91 90547 79097, hi@thenuancemedia.com

## Services
- [Meta ads](https://nuancemedia.agency/meta-ads.html): Facebook and Instagram ads with in-house creatives and weekly reporting
- [UGC videos](https://nuancemedia.agency/ugc.html): creator casting, scripts with multiple hooks, shooting and editing
- [Websites & SEO](https://nuancemedia.agency/website-seo.html): landing pages, Shopify stores, custom sites, technical and content SEO
- [All services, with what we do and don't do](https://nuancemedia.agency/services.html)
